_about: Where the happi database of sites/ios and the IOS profile collection disagree, the profile collection wins: it is what runs at the beamline and the simulated IOCs (ios-profile-collection, sim/) serve what its classes ask for. Found with ios-profile-collection sim/check_happi.py. Every entry says why. make_happi_db.py applies this file; do not edit the generated files by hand.

replace_text.reason: The profile's SpecsDetectorCam requests TOTAL_POINTS_ITERTION_RBV (sic) and the simulated IOC serves that spelling; the happi port had corrected the spelling.
